Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 93 now!
Synopsis :
Chandragupta clears Dhananand’s curiousity by revealing his identity as the prince of Pipliwan. Dhananand recalls the moments when he ignored the clue of his betrayal in the past but he remains adamant with his ego giving low complexity to Chandragupta. He asks Chandragupta to behead Chanakya in return of mercy for his life. Chandragupta gives open challenge to him and also declares to avenge for the loss of his father and empire. Meanwhile, Assaka king joins hand with Dhananand betraying Pipliwan soldiers.
